display.purpose: Funnel Display for focused onboarding and auth headings.

console-heading.purpose: One 32px page title for every sidebar destination.

console-heading-compact.purpose: The same page title at 28px on viewports 800px and below.

mono.purpose: IBM Plex Mono for labels, table headings, timestamps, tags, commands and identifiers.

metric.purpose: Funnel Display figures with tabular numerals.

shadows.name: shadow-paper
shadows.purpose: Retired inset highlight; panels are flat inside hairline frames.

motion.name: motion-fast
motion.purpose: Shared control and navigation state transitions.

motion.name: pending-spin
motion.purpose: Existing pending indicator rotation; reduced motion suppresses repetition.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Console transition and animation duration under prefers-reduced-motion, with one animation iteration.

motion.name: primary-plus
motion.purpose: The plus on a text-only primary button turns a quarter on hover.

narrative.overview: The shared OpenCrawl console carries the landing page: a light lavender-grey page, hairline frames, square corners, Funnel Display headings, Switzer or Geist reading text and IBM Plex Mono labels.
keyCharacteristics: Ink blocks are actions and navigation.
Lavender fills what is selected or featured.
